correctness.rationale: The support function is exactly the sum of the two largest absolute normal coordinates, and the signed roots form 2n(n-1) equal spherical-cap centers with nearest-angle pi/3. Exact neighbor enumeration gives 4n(n-1)(n-2) contacting pairs and a positive exclusion gap for every third cap. Tangent scaling x=O(epsilon), y=O(sqrt(epsilon)) and direct lens integration give the normalization C_n=4sqrt(3)(n-1)(n-2)(2/3)^(n/4)/pi. For n=3, a direct spherical Voronoi cell integral and its elementary antiderivative give the whole three-piece CDF. Independent cuboctahedral quadrature and n=4 exact disk-marginal checks were executed from the packaged verifier; all checks passed. The mathematical proof, not finite computation, establishes the universal claim.
